needs-triage.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

needs-info.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

ready-for-agent.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

wontfix.description: This will not be worked on

wayfinder:map.description: A wayfinder map: one big effort, its destination and decisions

wayfinder:research.description: Wayfinder ticket: a fact a decision waits on (AFK)

wayfinder:prototype.description: Wayfinder ticket: a rough artifact to react to (HITL)

wayfinder:grilling.description: Wayfinder ticket: a decision settled with the owner (HITL)

wayfinder:task.description: Wayfinder ticket: work that unblocks a decision

autopilot.description: A goal worked by a background autopilot brain session

autopilot-stuck.description: The dispatcher stopped restarting this autopilot goal

parked.description: waiting on a named event; not worked until it comes

provisional.description: A decision the brain took for the owner on autopilot; revert with tools.agentops veto

flow-fix.description: A fix of the pipeline itself: heads every queue

priority.description: The owner's push: heads every queue, before flow-fix

hard-push.description: A Priority ticket's merge cuts its repo's running batch
